quests.title: Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)

wild.place: Seafoam Islands B4F / Seafoam Islands, inner room

acquisitions.conditions: After the Cianwood Gym story opens the Resort Zone, enter Pal Park’s Fixed Catch mode for $10,000 with room for six more Pokémon in the PC. This standing Pokémon appears on Sunday or Friday. Bring your own Poké Balls.
